title: Oushun Jogakuen no Danyuu
synopsis:
In the prestigious setting of Oushun Jogakuen no Danyuu, a newcomer assumes the role of janitor to help elite students manage private desires within academy grounds. His first assignment centers on student council president Ichijou Saeki, whose flawless public image hides a need for someone to guide her away from constant performance. This arrangement lets her maintain composure while exploring a different dynamic in secret.

(Source: Hentai Haven)
